title: Reunion Route du Volcan
slogan: Saint Pierre to Pas de Bellecombe

waypoints.name: Saint Pierre
waypoints.advice: Saint Pierre is where the day begins. Next is Bourg Murat, 21 km on.

waypoints.name: Bourg Murat
waypoints.advice: Bourg Murat comes up 21 km in. Next is Plaine des Sables, 21 km on.

waypoints.name: Plaine des Sables
waypoints.advice: 42 km in you reach Plaine des Sables. Next is Pas de Bellecombe, 21 km on.

waypoints.name: Pas de Bellecombe
waypoints.advice: Pas de Bellecombe closes the day.

sections.advice: Saint Pierre → Bourg Murat is 23 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Bourg Murat → Plaine des Sables is 10 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Plaine des Sables → Pas de Bellecombe is 5 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Reunion Route du Volcan. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Reunion Route du Volcan
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 38 km this is Reunion Route du Volcan, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
